# Doorman

> A stack cookbook: choose a recipe, inspect branded services, compare alternatives and prices in tables, and copy a build prompt.

- Site: https://doorman.neorgon.com/
- One page: recipes, stack, cost comparison, builder tools, hard parts, prompts.
- Eighteen recipes, nine familiar-product references, fifteen service categories, twelve model-price rows and five coding tools.
- Pin a stack and compare it with the current choices. Share URLs preserve the configuration.
- Costs are editorial scenarios. AI token counts are illustrative assumptions, not measured project forecasts. Verify linked pricing sources.
- Build prompt and usage-fit research prompt can be copied or downloaded.
- Credential setup and troubleshooting: https://echeance.neorgon.com/#tutorials
- Plans remain in browser storage until exported or shared. Never put credentials in plan text.
- Neorgon tool index: https://neorgon.com/llms.txt
